name: rustup
label: rustup
description: Rust toolchains from rust-toolchain.toml or rust-toolchain.

tools.name: rust
list: echo stable; echo beta; echo nightly; rustup toolchain list </dev/null 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^no installed' | awk '{print $1}' | grep -vE '^(stable|beta|nightly)'; true
installed: rustup toolchain list </dev/null | grep -v '^no installed' | awk '{print $1}' | sed -E 's/-(x86_64|aarch64|i686|arm)[A-Za-z0-9_-]*$//' | sort -u

requires.name: rustup
check: if command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "rustup not found (install it: https://rustup.rs)" >&2; exit 1

requires.name: cc
check: if command -v cc >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "no C compiler (cc): Rust cannot link" >&2; exit 1
install:
set -eu; v=0.14.1; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) a=x86_64; s=24aeeec8af16c381934a6cd7d95c807a8cb2cf7df9fa40d359aa884195c4716c;; aarch64|arm64) a=aarch64; s=f7a654acc967864f7a050ddacfaa778c7504a0eca8d2b678839c21eea47c992b;; *) echo "no zig build for $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1;; esac; t=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT; curl -fsSL -o "$t/zig.tar.xz" "https://ziglang.org/download/$v/zig-$a-linux-$v.tar.xz"; echo "$s  $t/zig.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xJf "$t/zig.tar.xz" -C "$t"; rm -rf "$HOME/.local/zig"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; mv "$t/zig-$a-linux-$v" "$HOME/.local/zig"; printf '#!/bin/sh
for a; do shift; case "$a" in -Wl,--fix-cortex-a53-843419) ;; *) set -- "$@" "$a";; esac; done
exec "%s/.local/zig/zig" cc "$@"
' "$HOME" > "$HOME/.local/bin/cc"; chmod 0755 "$HOME/.local/bin/cc"

instructions.linux: Install gcc and libc headers with your package manager (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install build-essential)
instructions.any: Install a C compiler that provides `cc`
